title: Scooter's Coffee Now Available for Delivery Exclusively on DoorDash
summary: The drive-thru chain's exclusive move into delivery lands ahead of National Coffee Day on September 29, with a DoorDash exclusive promotion
body_markdown:
Today, DoorDash announced that[Scooter's Coffee](https://www.doordash.com/business/scooter-s-coffee-14263681) ® **is now available for delivery exclusively on the platform** , giving the drive-thru chain's fans a new way to order ahead of National Coffee Day on September 29.


As the exclusive delivery partner of Scooter’s Coffee, the chain’s ‘Licious Lineup drinks, Red Bull® Infusions, breakfast and anytime treats, crème cold brews, shakes, smoothies, and more can all be delivered directly to guests through the DoorDash app.


In 2025, there were **more than 80 million coffee orders placed on DoorDash** – growth that Scooter's Coffee has tapped into. Through this partnership, consumers now have delivery access to the chain’s menu for the first time through participating stores among the 900+ Scooter’s Coffee locations nationwide.


> *“Scooter's has built real loyalty around speed and a menu customers love. Bringing them onto DoorDash means that experience isn't limited when life gets in the way of making a drive-thru run,” said* ***Vishwa Chandra, Head of Enterprise Partnerships at DoorDash.*** *“We're proud to be the only place customers can get Scooter's delivered, and it's a good example of what we can do for merchants who've built something worth showing up for.”*


> *"Today's guests expect maximum convenience and our DoorDash partnership makes it easier than ever to get your Scooter’s Coffee fix,” said* ***Anna Faktorovich, Chief Marketing Officer at Scooter's Coffee.***


To mark the launch and celebrate National Coffee Day,[Scooter's Coffee](https://www.doordash.com/business/scooter-s-coffee-14263681) is offering a DoorDash exclusive **buy one, get one free deal*** on medium Caramelicious® drinks from September 27–29, 2026. This offer includes the original signature Caramelicious, the limited-time Pumpkin Caramelicious, the Caramelicious Crème Cold Brew, and any other drink with Caramelicious in its name. All espresso drinks can be ordered hot, iced, or blended.


Scooter's Coffee is live on DoorDash, and joins a growing roster of coffee brands on the platform.


**Terms & Conditions*


*Offer valid from 09/27/26 to 09/29/26. Buy one, get one free offer valid only on medium drinks that include “Caramelicious®” in their name. To redeem, add eligible items to your cart from participating Scooter’s Coffee locations, while supplies last. Discount applies to base item price only; fees, taxes, and gratuity still apply. Limit of one "Buy 1, get 1 free" per eligible item per order. DoorDash reserves the right to modify or cancel this offer at any time.*[See further terms and conditions at https://drd.sh/8ONpZP/](https://help.doordash.com/legal/en-CA/document?type=cx-promo-and-credits-terms&region=US&locale=en-US)
